extension.summary: Synchronize add-on settings between Kodi installations
extension.description: Modernized AddonSync service for Kodi 19+ with Kodi VFS network support, verified SHA-256 manifests and safer synchronization.
Modernisierte AddonSync-Version für Kodi 19+ mit Kodi-VFS-Netzwerkzugriff, verifizierten SHA-256-Manifesten und sichererer Synchronisierung.
extension.news:
v102.0.2 - Pointed add-on source and support metadata to the ICU83 maintained fork - Updated maintainer attribution for the modernized 102.x line
v102.0.1 - Fixed Kodi settings-dialog localization / blank labels - Normalized language PO files and added en_US fallback
v102.0.0 - Reworked service/manual entry points for Python 3 - Replaced broken copy and hash logic - Added VFS-safe recursive hashing and copying for local/SMB/NFS paths - Added JSON SHA-256 manifest with legacy hashdata.xml fallback - Added verified temporary copies before replacing client settings - Fixed manual sync and filter actions - Preserved existing AddonSync setting IDs for in-place upgrades
